title: fix(auth): a user with two-factor sign-in on is asked for their code after the password
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbRSWiurS43dXzxySsivhDtb)_

Fixes #29105

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:开启了双重验证(身份验证器 TOTP)的用户用密码登录后,Console 登录页会出现第二步:输入身份验证器里的 6 位验证码,或改用备用码;验证通过即登录。验证码错误会在原处提示并可重试;"返回登录"回到密码步骤。Console 自己的登录页和 `DefaultLoginPage` 都有这一步,十种语言包都有文案。
- **为什么改**:服务端早已支持两步登录(密码通过后返回 `twoFactorRedirect`,再由 `/two-factor/verify-totp` 或 `/verify-backup-code` 完成),但 Console 把这个回答丢掉了,登录页原样不动、没有输入框也没有任何提示,这类用户完全进不了 Console。
- **风险与回滚**:只改前端(`@object-ui/auth`、`app-shell`、`i18n`、`console`),服务端零改动;未开启双重验证的用户登录路径不变(有测试钉住)。`@object-ui/auth` 的公开类型新增了成员(拓宽)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx`(`signIn` 收到挑战时不登录、保存挑战;`verifySignInTwoFactor` 完成登录,挑战被服务端作废时清掉);`ui/packages/auth/src/TwoFactorChallengeForm.tsx`(新的验证码步骤);`ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts`(识别 `twoFactorRedirect`、丢弃那次回答里已被删掉的会话 token)。
- **两分钟验证**:`OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh -p 38417`,给 admin 开启 TOTP 后在 Console `/login` 用密码登录:出现验证码步骤;输错显示"That code is not valid…",输对进入 `/home`。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

A password sign-in for an account with two-factor sign-in on is answered by better-auth's `twoFactor()` plugin with `{ twoFactorRedirect: true, twoFactorMethods }`, no session, and a signed `two_factor` cookie that holds the pending sign-in for ten minutes. The Console ignored that answer. Now:

- **`@object-ui/auth` client.** `AuthClient.signIn` answers `{ twoFactor: { methods } }` for that case (new exported `SignInResult`, `TwoFactorChallenge`, `TwoFactorMethod`). The same answer carries `set-auth-token` for the session the server just deleted (measured: it resolves to no session), which the bearer fetch had stored; the client clears it. New `AuthClient.verifySignInTwoFactor(code, 'totp' | 'backup-code')` posts to the sign-in lane of `/two-factor/verify-totp` or `/two-factor/verify-backup-code` and stores the session token it answers.
- **Provider.** `useAuth()` gains `twoFactorChallenge`, `verifySignInTwoFactor` and `cancelTwoFactorChallenge`; `signIn` resolves `{ twoFactorRequired }`. The challenge clears on success, on "Back to sign in", on sign-out, and when the server reports it spent or expired (`TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS_REQUEST_NEW_CODE`, `INVALID_TWO_FACTOR_COOKIE`); a wrong code (`INVALID_CODE`, `INVALID_BACKUP_CODE`) keeps it.
- **`LoginForm`.** While a challenge is held it draws the new internal `TwoFactorChallengeForm` in place of its form: the code field (`inputMode="numeric"`, `autocomplete="one-time-code"`, spaces stripped), a link to a backup code and back, "Back to sign in", and the error in place. `onSuccess` fires only once the code is verified. Because the challenge lives in the provider, the console's dev-admin chip leads to the same step (its spinner now stops there). Controls use the phone floor #29136 introduced (`AUTH_TOUCH_TARGET_CLASS`, 44 px, 16 px input text).
- **Strings.** Ten `LoginFormLabels` members (`twoFactor*`), passed by both login pages from `auth.login.twoFactor*`, and five refusal codes in `signInRefusalMessages` from `auth.login.errors.twoFactor*`, in all ten packs.

No server package is touched; no metadata key or option is added.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/twoFactorSignIn-29105.test.tsx` (real `AuthProvider` + `LoginForm` over a stub client): a TOTP user signs in with password then code (`onSuccess` only after the code); a wrong code shows the mapped error in place and a retry succeeds; a backup code works; "Back to sign in" returns to the password step; a dropped challenge returns there with the reason; no authenticator method offers backup codes only; a user without two-factor is signed straight in, unchanged.
- New `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/twoFactorSignIn-client-29105.test.ts`: the client maps `twoFactorRedirect` to a challenge and stores no token, keeps the plain session path, posts each code kind to its endpoint, and keeps the server `code` on a refusal.
- `createAuthClient.test.ts`: one assertion reads `result.user?.email` for the widened `signIn` answer.
- Ablation, after committing: `LoginForm`'s challenge branch disabled reds 6 of the 7 LoginForm cases (the unchanged non-two-factor case stays green, as it should); the client's `twoFactorRedirect` check disabled reds 2 of 6 client cases. `ablation-replace.mjs` restored each file (empty `git diff HEAD`).

## Run record

Live, on `pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh` with `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true`, the seeded admin enrolled through `/two-factor/enable` with a TOTP computed from the served secret.

| Step | Answer |
|---|---|
| password sign-in, enrolled | 200 `{"twoFactorRedirect":true,"twoFactorMethods":["totp"]}`, session cookies expired, `two_factor` cookie set |
| verify-totp, wrong code | 401 `INVALID_CODE` |
| verify-totp, right code | 200 `{ token, user }`, session cookie set, `two_factor` expired; `get-session` with the token answers the admin |
| verify-backup-code / wrong | 200 `{ token, user }` / 401 `INVALID_BACKUP_CODE` |
| verify-totp with no challenge cookie | 401 `INVALID_TWO_FACTOR_COOKIE` |

Real browser (Playwright Chromium, the Console from `ui/apps/console` source through Vite over that backend): at 1280 px the password step leads to the code step with no token stored; a wrong code shows "That code is not valid. Check your authenticator app and try again." in place; the right code (typed as "123 456") lands on `/home`; "Back to sign in" returns to the password step; a backup code signs in. At 375 x 812 (`isMobile`): the field, Verify and both links are 44 px tall, the field text is 16 px, no horizontal scroll, and with the viewport shrunk by a 336 px keyboard the field (263 to 307) and Verify (323 to 367) sit inside the 476 px left. Screenshots are in the project folder `issue-29105/`, not on GitHub, as the card asks.

## Acceptance notes

- `AuthClient` gains a required method, `verifySignInTwoFactor`, like every earlier addition to that interface: a third-party `AuthClient` implementation must add it to type-check. Declared `Clause-②: yes (widening)` as claimed.
- The password step's own lockout code `ACCOUNT_LOCKED` has no entry in `signInRefusalMessages` (before this PR too), so it shows the server's English message; this PR adds only the two-factor step's codes.
- After verification the session is `{ token }`, as phone sign-in already does: the verify endpoints answer `{ token, user }` with no session envelope, and the provider's session reads only the token.

## Verification

Readings at head `606f6f61` (main `f2bf2938` merged, which carries #29136 and #29159).
